</properties>
<iconMetadata>null</iconMetadata>
<content>
Status: P31 TASK-PACKAGE CORRECTION CANDIDATE. The previous P31 package preflights passed structurally but missed a real Scene-owner dependency. This correction supersedes only the previous Scene source-scope exclusion and adds explicit Scene prepare/commit/abort obligations. It does not authorize source changes until the corrected package is materialized and all required preflights pass.

## Exact result and base

- Repository: Mostorm-Labs/axiom
- Feature baseline: codex/selection-summary-batch3 @ c7f874395d55952e9d5288e2a336a21747f37f11
- Current D07 branch: codex/fc04-d07-selection-audit
- Current reported P32 result: 15e76458f3872be4d1b51d4aac05eb8402719014
- Previous P32 task anchor: 832866a2d001a247c4eb374c1fb1899258a6f6cf
- P32 report: [https://github.com/Mostorm-Labs/axiom/blob/15e76458f3872be4d1b51d4aac05eb8402719014/.aegis/results/FC04-D07-AB-P32-001/report.md](https://github.com/Mostorm-Labs/axiom/blob/15e76458f3872be4d1b51d4aac05eb8402719014/.aegis/results/FC04-D07-AB-P32-001/report.md)
- P32 commands: [https://github.com/Mostorm-Labs/axiom/blob/15e76458f3872be4d1b51d4aac05eb8402719014/.aegis/results/FC04-D07-AB-P32-001/commands.json](https://github.com/Mostorm-Labs/axiom/blob/15e76458f3872be4d1b51d4aac05eb8402719014/.aegis/results/FC04-D07-AB-P32-001/commands.json)

The reported branch head is 15e76458... and the P32 report is an execution result, not a product Gate PASS. Keep the OOM fix and all prior evidence. Do not use main as the feature baseline.

## Root cause

The current Scene owner combines preparation and publication in the live apply path:

- IncrementalRuntimeCoordinator exposes plan/apply/recover; apply runs preparation and invokes publication before returning.
- SceneBinding::synchronize calls Scene::applyPreparedDelta with the publish callback in the same call.
- RuntimeScene::PreparedPublication and its prepare/publish methods are private to the existing Scene/Coordinator ownership.
- A real call to apply as a reservation would advance Scene/RuntimeScene publication and notify observers before the grouped canonical intent is known to have succeeded.

The prior P31 package excluded Scene-owner changes and did not bind an existing prepare-only seam. This is a package-scope defect, not proof of an upstream semantic conflict. The previous P31 structural preflight PASS remains historical; it did not prove the missing seam existed.

## Correction requested

Materialize a new versioned P31 package (do not overwrite v0.1 or v0.2 historical packages) whose task\_anchor is the exact current result revision after verifying local ancestry and worktree state. The package must authorize the existing Scene owner to expose a private, real, unpublished prepare / no-fail commit / abort seam for the D07 grouped intent.

The seam must:

1. Prepare actual Scene and RuntimeScene participant resources against the staged post-intent states before the first canonical mutation.
2. Not change visible Scene/RuntimeScene records, revision/generation, hit-test/query/draw-list results, damage/invalidation publication, observer callbacks, or public snapshots during prepare.
3. Retain the real coordinator, SceneBinding, Scene, RuntimeScene, participant owners, checkpoint/fault-injection path and recovery ownership. No detached replacement coordinator or test-only fake preparer.
4. Reserve all fallible Scene record-store, render, spatial-index, damage, snapshot, invalidation, result and publication resources before canonical mutation.
5. Provide a no-fail/no-allocation publish/commit step after the whole canonical intent succeeds, or prove an existing equivalent seam. Abort before canonical mutation must discard prepared state with no visible changes.
6. Preserve each real Operation's ID, generation successor, commit stamp, ChangeSet and ordered eligible DataBridge notifications. Scene observers must never see a partial failed intent. The commit must not silently collapse the semantic Operations into one synthetic Operation or erase per-operation metadata.
7. Keep ordinary single-operation Scene apply/synchronize behavior compatible by implementing existing methods as prepare+commit wrappers where appropriate.
8. If per-operation observer contracts cannot be preserved while keeping the local grouped intent coherent, stop with AUTHORITY\_CONFLICT; do not silently weaken 07-14 or reinterpret compensation as pre-write rejection.

This is a private product Runtime/Scene C++ seam. Do not add public C ABI symbols, wire types, schema or a global canonical Transaction.

## Newly authorized Scene source surface

Primary Scene-owner files:

- runtime/scene/include/canvas/scene/incremental\_runtime\_coordinator.hpp
- runtime/scene/src/incremental\_runtime\_coordinator.cpp
- runtime/scene/include/canvas/scene/scene\_binding.hpp
- runtime/scene/src/scene\_binding.cpp
- runtime/scene/include/canvas/scene/scene.hpp
- runtime/scene/src/scene.cpp
- runtime/scene/include/canvas/scene/scene\_types.hpp

Focused Scene verification:

- runtime/scene/tests/incremental\_runtime\_atomic\_publication\_test.cpp
- runtime/scene/tests/incremental\_runtime\_coordinator\_test.cpp
- runtime/scene/tests/scene\_atomicity\_test.cpp
- runtime/scene/tests/scene\_binding\_test.cpp
- runtime/scene/tests/incremental\_runtime\_recovery\_test.cpp
- runtime/scene/tests/incremental\_runtime\_test\_access.hpp
- runtime/scene/tests/CMakeLists.txt
- verification/fc04\_d07/audit\_test.cpp
- verification/fc04\_d07/postcommit\_fault.cpp
- verification/fc04\_d07/CMakeLists.txt

Conditional participant-owner files, only if the implementation design preflight identifies a concrete missing no-fail prepare/commit seam:

- runtime/scene/include/canvas/scene/scene\_record\_store.hpp and runtime/scene/src/scene\_record\_store.cpp
- runtime/scene/include/canvas/scene/render\_scene.hpp, runtime/scene/src/direct\_render\_scene.cpp, runtime/scene/src/shadow\_render\_scene.cpp
- runtime/scene/include/canvas/scene/spatial\_index.hpp, runtime/scene/src/linear\_spatial\_index.cpp, runtime/scene/src/uniform\_grid\_spatial\_index.cpp
- runtime/scene/include/canvas/scene/damage\_tracker.hpp and runtime/scene/src/damage\_tracker.cpp
- runtime/scene/include/canvas/scene/scene\_delta.hpp, runtime/scene/src/scene\_delta.cpp, runtime/scene/include/canvas/scene/spatial\_delta.hpp, runtime/scene/src/spatial\_delta.cpp

Each conditionally touched file must be justified in the implementation design record and locked into the corrected source manifest before mutation. If an unlisted owner, new module, or wider scope is needed, stop and return to P31 instead of editing it.

## Required new Scene oracles

- SCENE-PREP-01 — real coordinator prepare performs no visible publication: Scene/RuntimeScene generation and revision, records, queries, hit-test, draw-list, damage/invalidation, and observer counts remain unchanged.
- SCENE-PREP-02 — abort after successful prepare leaves all visible and canonical state unchanged.
- SCENE-PREP-03 — participant prepare failure at each real checkpoint leaves all visible state unchanged and releases staged resources.
- SCENE-PREP-04 — successful commit publishes the coherent post-intent state exactly according to the accepted publication contract; no fallible allocation remains at commit.
- SCENE-PREP-05 — stale Scene/semantic basis rejects before canonical mutation.
- SCENE-PREP-06 — existing single-operation apply/synchronize and recovery tests remain green.
- D07 grouped-intent positive oracle uses the real CanvasEditingRuntime + explicit intent owner + Scene coordinator; multiple typed Operations create one user-visible Undo unit.
- D07 failure containment/OOM remains blocking; preserve the 11 passing D07 checks and all 160 Selection regression IDs.

The test must use the actual Scene owner and observer/checkpoint seams. A synthetic preflight failpoint that moves a genuinely post-prefix failure to before the first write is not acceptable. Record the real phase and pre/post state for every injected fault.

## Required package preflight

- Verify repository identity, current branch, exact result HEAD, clean/dirty state and ancestry from both feature anchor and prior task anchor.
- Preserve previous P32 result/report/commands as immutable history.
- Create a new versioned package directory and content-addressed source/Authority/Verification/evidence bindings. Do not edit prior package locks in place.
- Update allowed source paths, implementation context, test matrix, required evidence, terminal blockers and package materialization hashes.
- Re-run PackageBindingPreflight, EvidenceContractPreflight, DesignPreflight, and the D07 package preflight on the new package.
- All three existing P32 preflights from v0.1 remain historical evidence only; they do not validate this scope correction.

## Execution status boundary

This correction authorizes only the P31 package update and its preflights. It does not authorize further product-source changes until the corrected package is materialized and preflights pass. D07-A/B remain incomplete; D06-B remains separately OPEN; no Gate/DEV/PHYS/P34 PASS is implied.
</content>
